current_issues: Audio detected but text not recognized

features: 6 specialized agents (Voice, Language, Conversation, Recognition, Improvement, Coordinator)

identified_improvements.improvement: Try Whisper large-v2 or large-v3 models for better accuracy
identified_improvements.reason: Base model may not be accurate enough for all scenarios
identified_improvements.implementation: Upgrade from base to large-v2 (if speed allows) or use model quantization

identified_improvements.improvement: Add spectral subtraction and adaptive filtering
identified_improvements.reason: Current denoising may not handle all noise types
identified_improvements.implementation: Add librosa effects (harmonic/percussive separation) and adaptive noise cancellation

identified_improvements.improvement: Use WebRTC VAD or Silero VAD instead of energy-based
identified_improvements.reason: More sophisticated VAD may reduce false positives
identified_improvements.implementation: Replace energy-based VAD with webrtcvad library (already in requirements)

identified_improvements.improvement: Implement streaming TTS for faster perceived latency
identified_improvements.implementation: Use Coqui streaming mode or switch to Piper TTS for faster generation

identified_improvements.improvement: Add multiple recognition engines (Whisper, DeepSpeech, Wav2Vec2)
identified_improvements.reason: Different models may catch what others miss
identified_improvements.implementation: Try Whisper first, then DeepSpeech, then Wav2Vec2 as fallbacks

identified_improvements.improvement: Ensure proper sample rate and format for Whisper
identified_improvements.reason: Whisper expects 16kHz mono, may need resampling
identified_improvements.implementation: Add explicit resampling to 16kHz and mono channel conversion

identified_improvements.improvement: Use conversation context to improve recognition
identified_improvements.reason: Previous context can help disambiguate unclear speech
identified_improvements.implementation: Pass previous conversation context to Whisper prompt parameter

identified_improvements.improvement: Add Audio Quality Agent to monitor and improve recording
identified_improvements.reason: Need specialized monitoring for audio quality issues
identified_improvements.implementation: Create Audio Quality Agent that analyzes recordings and suggests improvements

identified_improvements.improvement: Stream recognition chunks as they arrive
identified_improvements.implementation: Process audio chunks incrementally rather than waiting for full recording

identified_improvements.improvement: Use quantized models for faster inference
identified_improvements.reason: Current models may be slower than necessary
identified_improvements.implementation: Use int8 or float16 quantization for Whisper model
